confirmed.GO: Both B-A and B-Parent must strictly improve strict sequence balanced accuracy, T1 recall and mean-candidate balanced accuracy. FLAIR and Dallas overall/same/different must not fall versus either reference. When swap summaries are supplied, B opposite-class changes must not fall versus A. Counts/cosine are diagnostics only.
confirmed.admission: Current human action, independent different-agent-kind source/input/scope digest, once-only ledger, source rehash and canonical persistent output root are required. This review is not an accepted exact launch-scope review.
confirmed.audit: Backward mutation of a parameter is refused before any update. Author synthetic faults also require pre-restore Adam/RNG equality; rollout permits intentional R1 only while preserving optimizer/parameters.
confirmed.crash_recovery: Injected fault after atomic terminal rename recovers the committed boundary without another rollout, old scoring, backward or update. Incomplete reserved attempts fail closed.
confirmed.evaluation: New authentic Adam52 parent/child validator and matched F32 serial evaluator; no-update arms alias parent without duplicate calls. Prospective records/token/source/policy/budget freeze contains no fabricated child hashes; terminal finalization must reproduce frozen part.
confirmed.fairness: One shared F4+T4 rollout. A=F4/T4 and B=F2T2/F2T2; 1/8 per admitted response; both arms restore identical parent R0 and independently receive at most one update. Gate is identical in arms, explicitly a stage change from the original parent strict gate.
confirmed.numerical_gate: State preflight makes no probability claim. Fresh shared8 own-context rollout-versus-old scoring parity <=0.002 must pass before any gradient/step; parity failure may consume the sole rollout, with no resampling.
confirmed.parent: Original non-nested boundary114/Adam52 metadata schema and frozen receipt/adapter identities, not the lost Adam60 or a fabricated offset conversion.
confirmed.saved_summary: Mean is primary; sum and first are separate secondary readouts. Exact40 rows, class recalls, invalids, correct-minus-wrong margins, deltas and costs are reported without best-readout selection.
confirmed.two_phase: Both parent-state gradients and hash-bound tensor/metadata archives plus CPU comparison precede the first persistent optimizer step. Injected B-gradient failure leaves zero updates.

limitations: CPU numpy fake-backend and synthetic-row fixtures do not establish native F32 gradients, probabilities, cache compatibility, actual parameter integrity or accuracy.
Exact real runtime/source/input closure and final launch scope still require preparation and independent binding review, plus genuine human authorization. No launch token is issued here.
Operation-start deadlines and API counters are not interruptible hard wall limits or hardware kernel counts; autograd checkpoint recomputation and generation lookahead are additional work.
Engineering evaluation is internal dev only (four sequence people); it does not establish independent generalization or clinical utility. Swap aliases reuse real rows and are not independent samples.
A GO means only a candidate requiring new authorization, not permission for more training. Mean/sum/first cannot be selected after outcomes.
The inherited parent-to-stage gate change is explicit and shared by A/B, so this is a local Vero-style control rather than a complete official Vero reproduction.
Whole legacy suite was not rerun. Parent-reported legacy workspace/dependency failures are not independently resolved by these targeted passes.
CPU cache reconstruction has a separate independent review; no actual conversion or native execution result is certified by this main-source review.
primary_implementer: Claude Code; independent Codex fixtures and review
privacy: Review contains aggregate/source/test hashes only; no patient identities, response text/token arrays, MRI pixels, weights, optimizer arrays or private absolute runtime paths.
scope: Frozen source, synthetic CPU transaction faults, evaluation admission and conservative GO policy; not a native launch or accuracy approval
